versions.changelog:
- Initial release of "AI Agent Oversight & Safety" skill, focusing on safe, transparent, and effective deployment of autonomous AI agents.
- Covers best practices for agent monitoring, safety constraints, audit trails, escalation protocols, and continuous evaluation.
- Provides infrastructure patterns, sample code, and detailed workflows for applying oversight in real-world AI operations.
- Emphasizes alignment between agent behavior and organizational goals, policy compliance, and human-in-the-loop intervention.
